name: Scrob
short_desc: Open-source, self-hosted media tracking - your personal Letterboxd + Trakt.
author: Miguel Ribeiro
description: Scrob syncs your libraries from Jellyfin, Plex, and Emby, tracks your watch history, ratings, and personal lists, and lets you push your activity back to your media server - all from a clean, app-like web interface that installs as a PWA on any device..
